title: festuca ovina var. pannonica
intro: Festuca ovina var. pannonica, commonly known as Pannonian sheep's fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body from various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Pannonian sheep's fescue include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral effects, making it a potential treatment for various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
